stages.title: Baseline and architecture
stages.stateReason: The verified Stage 1–7 checkpoint, architecture mapping, runbook, isolated bootstrap worktree, and deterministic registry complete the automation baseline.
manualBlockers: Long-term external-account ownership remains a human governance decision before production.

stages.title: Live/repository visual and functional parity
stages.stateReason: 40 route/viewport pairs and four interaction scenarios passed with zero measured geometry, style, structural, console, or interaction mismatches.
manualBlockers: The live reference can drift after the dated capture; recapture before final release.

stages.title: Legacy and dead-code cleanup
stages.stateReason: Proven-dead WordPress, analytics, admin, and font artifacts were removed while used recovery paths and theme behavior were retained and parity-tested.

stages.title: Technical SEO and indexability
stages.stateReason: All 56 indexable pages match the sitemap and canonical contract; repository status, host, trailing-slash, preview-noindex, and 404 behavior have deterministic checks.
manualBlockers: Verify headers, robots, sitemap, and redirect behavior again after an authorized production cutover.

stages.title: Metadata and international SEO
stages.stateReason: All 56 pages pass language, reciprocal hreflang, x-default, canonical, title, description, Open Graph, and Twitter consistency checks.
manualBlockers: Nine legacy excerpts still require client-approved translation or replacement text.

stages.title: Semantic HTML and page structure
stages.stateReason: All 56 pages have validated H1 and landmark structure; the four reference pages retain measured visual and functional parity.

stages.title: Project-page SEO architecture
stages.stateReason: All 52 bilingual project pages are source-validated and support approved facts, narrative, and editorial relationships without inventing missing content.
manualBlockers: Project facts, publishable locations, translations, and editorial relationships require Esencial approval.

stages.title: Image SEO and responsive delivery
stages.stateReason: All 104 generated image uses pass alt, intrinsic-dimension, loading, responsive-photo, and drawing-preservation checks; 20 WebP derivatives are deterministic.
manualBlockers: Credits, rights, captions, and filename migration require approved editorial and legal data.

stages.title: Structured data and entity graph
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 55d07f3 validates one factual entity graph across all 56 indexable pages, including 52 CreativeWork entities and visible project breadcrumbs.
manualBlockers: Unsupported organization or project facts must not be added without client confirmation.

stages.title: Performance and Core Web Vitals
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 70a05f0 adds deterministic responsive grid media and a six-case performance gate; merged S9/S10 code then passed 40 parity pairs, four interactions, accessibility, functionality, and the full build.

stages.title: Accessibility
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit a7e2e61 adds keyboard, focus, zoom, motion, naming and reflow safeguards with zero mismatch across 40 live/local viewport pairs.

stages.title: Analytics cleanup and measurement
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 90af57e validates consent-gated Vercel measurement, fail-closed provider/origin states and zero analytics runtime when Cookiebot is absent.
manualBlockers: External Vercel Analytics, Cookiebot, and Search Console account actions require authorized owners and secrets.

stages.title: CMS and Sanity SEO safeguards
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit b003657 enforces draft-only Studio writes, bilingual publication and media-rights safeguards, complete-snapshot export validation, and deterministic clean Studio/root builds without external Sanity writes.
manualBlockers: No Sanity production writes or role/account changes without separate authorization.

stages.title: CI and automated SEO release gates
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit aa6bef1 enforces 13 ordered fail-closed release gates, immutable actions, frozen installs, least-privilege trust separation, deterministic generation, evidence summaries and three negative contract fixtures; no remote CI or deployment ran.
manualBlockers: Remote CI execution requires a later authorized push; local workflow validation remains allowed.

stages.title: Final integrated validation
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 85aad30 passed four specialist audits plus coordinator reruns: 56-page SEO/build, 40 visual pairs, four interactions, accessibility, runtime budgets, exact Node determinism, Studio build/audit, 14 CI gates, six negative fixtures, and perceptual quality checks for 78 uncropped image derivatives; no external mutation occurred.
manualBlockers: Production release, DNS, deployment, and final go/no-go remain separately authorized human decisions.

stages.title: Sanity access and safe CMS sandbox gate
stages.stateReason: The replacement ignored local token passed authenticated read-only access for project g6xm8j7l/production (66 visible documents, 52 published projects, zero drafts), and all 30 Studio workspace safeguards passed without an external mutation.
manualBlockers: No production document mutation, Studio deployment, dataset migration, role change, push, PR, or DNS change is authorized by this read-only gate.

stages.title: CMS visual system and single-workspace architecture
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 641129c adds the accessible Esencial Studio theme, one vertically flowing workspace and stable S17/S18/S19 extension contracts; independent Studio, TypeScript, lint, full root-build, image-quality and orchestration gates passed without public image/frontend changes or external mutation.
manualBlockers: Material visual redesign choices outside Esencial's established frontend identity require human approval.

stages.title: Project editor, filter taxonomy and grid navigation
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 72cf09c adds draft-only bilingual project-heading editing, explicit filter membership and keyboard-operable grid inclusion/order with exact legacy fallback; independent contract, TypeScript, lint, Studio, 30-safeguard, full root-build, image-quality and orchestration gates passed.
manualBlockers: Filter labels, editorial naming and project membership are content decisions; workers may implement selectors and validation but must not invent classifications.

stages.title: Live frontend preview and responsive layout guardrails
stages.stateReason: Integrated commits 6a72dcd and 5a0913b add protected responsive preview, deterministic layout diagnostics and guaranteed viewport re-handshake; W0 repeated layout fixtures, TypeScript, lint, Studio build, 30 safeguards, full 56-page build, image-quality and 40-pair/4-interaction parity checks after S17 composition.
manualBlockers: Protected preview origin and draft-mode secrets require authorized staging configuration; local deterministic preview remains required without it.

stages.title: Analytics dashboard, consent and privacy controls
stages.stateReason: Integrated commits 2b2c9dc, 80d5023 and 4bc4aa5 add consent-gated real-data analytics, machine-enforced choice expiry, explicit daily-visitor sums and strict nested response validation; W0 repeated 21 client contract mutations, consent/API fixtures, TypeScript, lint, Studio build, 30 safeguards and the full 56-page/image-quality build with no public diff or external activation.
manualBlockers: Analytics providers, privacy text, controller identity, retention periods and final legal approval remain human/external decisions.
No non-essential analytics may load before informed consent; reject and accept must be equally easy and consent must be withdrawable.

stages.title: Integrated CMS workspace and frontend synchronization
stages.stateReason: Integrated commit 79bc38e composes S17-S19, registers published navigation, synchronizes authored grid/filter/feed behavior and removes dormant Studio paths; W0 independently repeated 14 integration/negative cases, Sanity export fixtures, 30 Studio safeguards, consent/analytics, TypeScript, lint, Studio build and the full 56-page/image-quality build with exact inactive public fallback.
manualBlockers: No production publish, dataset migration or remote Studio deployment without separate authorization.

stages.title: CMS usability, accessibility and editorial acceptance
stages.stateReason: Runs against the integrated CMS workspace.
manualBlockers: Final wording and editor acceptance require the site owner; automated checks cannot certify legal compliance or subjective usability alone.

stages.title: Final CMS and workflow validation
stages.stateReason: Blocked until the complete CMS extension has passed integration and editorial QA.
manualBlockers: Production release, Sanity Studio deployment, domain changes, analytics activation and legal sign-off remain separately authorized human decisions.
